questions: Are multiple consecutive delimiters (e.g., commas, spaces) treated as a single delimiter, or do they produce empty strings in the output?
Should leading or trailing delimiters be ignored (trimmed) or produce empty strings?
Are there any other delimiters besides commas and spaces (e.g., tabs, newlines, punctuation)?
Should words retain their original case, or be normalized (e.g., lowercased)?
If the input contains only delimiters (e.g., ', ,'), should it return an empty list or list with empty strings?
Are delimiters inside quoted substrings (if any) considered delimiters, or part of the word?
Should the function handle Unicode whitespace or only ASCII spaces?
Is the order of words in the output required to match the input order, or can it be arbitrary?
